Taking a break from working on the Whisper Update to present an announcement.

[list]
[*] Bloom Slider
[*] Game Music Slider

As it may be news to some, a lot of my continued passion for Souls-likes came from watching Speed Runs on the Games Done Quick twitch streams. It enthuses my passion for developing games, seeing how players play them, and seeing the impact the gaming community has on the world.

We're gonna keep it pushing. We've definitely got enough to make new content and finish the game. It'll take more if we plan on working on it full time. I.E I make this post from my day job lol.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/92d03f1cd724602c26b3cba1f822c9eb825ecd96.jpg[/img]

[h3]THE CRUCIBLE[/h3]
Inspired by FABLE and it's spectacular side content, The Crucible is a menagarie of creatures and criminals collected by legendary game hunter Iver Harraldson. Deep in Solemn lies a once abandoned fortress gifted to the legend in hopes of appeasing an ancient debt between him and royalty. Players can head there to face various enemies rarely found in Baltane and captured criminals forced to fight for their freedom. Take the challenge and unlock unique weapons and armor.


[h3]CHARACTER OVERHAUL[/h3]
Apart from FADE's bosses that need to be crafted we have a unique opportunity with our talented 3d artist to attempt something impactful for the player experience. Taking notes from incredible character creators found in Dragons Dogma and other classic RPGs, we will create a unique character creator to handcraft your character and divine your own personal lore. Additionally you'll get access to the five most common races in Baltane. Baltaen, Ugarian, Alidan, Rosaran, and Corvin. 

[h3]ENDGAME OVERHAUL[/h3]
Having been in development for 4 years, FADEs plot and story has been in development for even longer as it is a story that I have held dear for a long time. Once the homunculus are at rest and the nation has been saved, a new threat still looms on the horizon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/cea719e689758dc9a5fea9c2ac04b4d43e790d46.jpg[/img]

 Rumored that two homunculi have gone rogue and have their own plans, you'll have to head to Alvash and solve the settlements woes. Bearing the size of half of Baltane, face new sea themed and Lovecraftian threats in this cursed ocean bound town. 

That being said I end off with an additional thank you. I have high hopes for this campaign and as the title states, our journey is far from over.

notes.content:
[h1]Hey Outlanders![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/143cfa505816bdff7eaeb40dfa14336d7f67f622.png[/img]
Had to delay the update a little to do some performance improvements to prepare for new content. Additionally a classic case of life trying to get in the way. Went through a substantial change at my day job which has resulted in me being on a new job hunt. Shouldn't be too hard to find something just as stable. It's just gonna take a while so I'll have to put up with some big changes at my current job in the meantime. 

Enough about me though, lets talk about the good stuff. 

[h1]BUG AND GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
Here is a quick list of the bugs and changes we tackled in this patch:

Fixed issue where knockback on player by bosses would send them in wrong direction
Resolved issue where some enemy deaths may impact performance.
Split Green Pass into two areas to improve its performance further.
Added wildlings to the mines, mining mechanic feature coming in future update
Added voice lines to Nerizana in the magic shop and additionally changed her shop items.
Modified main town shop inventory, future changes planned to better suit Baltane town area.
Increased gold reward values for certain side quests in Baltane. 
Fixed issue where Corvin boss wouldn't trigger doors to lock at boss fight start.
Add new Wildling Drake enemy
Resolved issues where the Wildling Archer would shoot three arrows instead of two during its charge skill.
Adjust aura drop rates for enemies in green pass to better match level where they are discovered. 
Removed Wildling Knight enemy to be optimized and placed in later content.
Added new magic weapons
Retooled Blue Aura Mace to Azure Aura mace to align it more to the lightning element.

[h1]UPCOMING PLANS[/h1]

To give you guys an update on upcoming content, we hope to deliver the following in the upcoming update:

Finish fleshing out Baltane NPC lines and dialogue
Add Downtown Whisper Area to give players access to fight more Grimwick enemies and face four new bosses. In addition three new quest lines that revolve around investigating Whisper. 

Access to the Red Tail Forest outside of the Celeste Settlement. This will include new living armors to face against including a longsword slinging warrior and a caster that acts as a cleric and shoots blue blade magic at its foes.

Lastly, depending on how much time gets consumed by these tasks, if I am able I am also planning to add the Sewer area back under Baltane and the Guard training camp. This would give players access to the Guard Training quest and the two sewer quests.

Looking forward to bringing you all more content.

[h1]WHATS UP OUTLANDERS[/h1]

First some general updates. We haven't had any luck finding a publisher and we had some minor setbacks by the kickstarter not being funded. We plan to try again in the coming weeks with a new easier to reach goal. For any that missed out, our community compiled a pretty compelling trailer that nearly raised 10,000. Shouts out to our lead voice actor Nathaniel(Voice of Czanth) for always bringing his best to voice overs. 

[previewyoutube=azCSjp_H3Mc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]WHAT MAKES THIS UPDATE SPECIAL?[/h1]
The following is a patch notes and game progress update for the community and all those that come after. In addition to this post, I'll be recording a video going over the updates tomorrow on my youtube channel. 

As many who have followed or played this game over the years since it launched in early access, FADE was originally my foot in the door for designing RPGs. I learned a lot about game design, optimization, marketing, and a whole slew of over things I'd take designing combat animations over any day. 

Today we've reached a big milestone with FADE's Rebuild update. This update focuses around new content for players who supported the project for years or recently, all new combat improvements and new weapons, and a slew of new narrative features. I recommend players start a fresh character and dive in to get a new experience with FADE and to see where we're going from here.

Now every patch notes reviewers favorite part. The actual patch notes. Keep in mind I kind of aggressively correct bugs, so I'm going to focus on the ones that the community experienced before and other changes. 

[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2]

[list]
[*] Made changes to the players rotation system to better suit each combat style.  Shooting with the bow or changing bow stance now locks them to face forward to where they are looking/aiming to make it easier to line up shots on controller. Additionally you can no longer sprint and aim which was causing many to either miss their targets by panicking or get an unfair advantage on enemies/bosses.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/a122e8acb553bd7949eeac45686ed0be1db61058.png[/img]
[*] Added the new blacksmithing system. Certain weapons can be brought to Aedern and can be upgraded to + 5 using upgrade materials dropped by enemies or found in the world. Not all of the weapons have support, but more will be added in future updates until all weapons have at least a tier 5 upgrade.

[*] Aura Flask Modification - Proposed for a long time, bosses now drop special aura items which can be used to change how your potion functions. Currently their are three different types of potions in the game which can be modified by using a bosses soul at a aura pot found in the players hub.

[*] Hit box adjustments and performance improvements on older enemies - Some of the older AIs  brought over from FADE's old build had some quirks coming back to unreal engine 4. This change makes it so they now act less sporadic, making it easier to get a rhythm of how they fight so you can respect their range properly. 

[*] New Dialogue Options - Some  the new NPCS have fleshed out and voiced dialogue. Being nosy will reward you with special keywords which can be used by other NPCS to give you items or more backstory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/e6d3f7965a2c71fcc9e22923e7394ad2149d87aa.png[/img]

[*] NEW Dialogue type - New Dialogue blueprint has been added from the old build that allows you to walk up to NPCS and engage in short one sided conversations where you listen to what they have to say. It animates well and hides your UI during the conversation to make it easier to focus on. 

[*] STAGGER Overhaul - Increased the impact of stagger on combat. Now using heavies and varying other move types act to multiply your stagger rates to reward you for riskier or more time consuming attacks. If you have enough stamina once their stagger meter is broken, you can perform a front stab or backstab by just pressing light attack and forward.

[*] NEW AREAS - To start fleshing out Baltane, this new update includes 5 new areas all heading towards CELESTE which will be the focus of the next big update. Though the new areas run well, the Wildling enemy type seems to impact performance on death, but soon they will be replaced temporarily with FADE's new enemy type "Imperial drakes".

[*] DAEDULUS DOOR - In the early build of the game, DAEDULUS DOORS are hinted as an option to gain treasure and reward exploration. The first ones been added, and you'll have to do some treasure hunting yourself if you're gonna convince him to open his door. 
[/list]

[h2]GAMES CURRENT STATE[/h2]

Currently FADE has enough content for you to start the first Chapter. The following content that comes after it is, heading to Celeste, the mining settlement. Players will have to delve deep underground fighting Imperial Drakes, Giant insects, and living armors to find Oderys, the homunculus monarch in charge there, also known as Lust. 

Alongside this area will be additions to Whisper, access to Whisper downtown and same as before, three knew bosses and larger over arching questlines. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/143cfa505816bdff7eaeb40dfa14336d7f67f622.png[/img]
Lastly the games first Aura Dungeons will be available. Aura dungeons are opportunities to get rare items and weapons. Each presents a puzzle that needs to be resolved in order to uncover their secrets. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/29553f8e737fd5937aeec3218807e76ec8f8254d.png[/img]

[h1]WHATS NEXT?[/h1]
Now that we've gotten over the hump that was effectively starting over we can start adding new side quests, weapons, enemies, and various other RPG elements back into the game over time alongside new content.  The next patches will target the new area of Celeste, The unexplored areas of Whisper and new additional content in Baltane, including the sewers and Baltane uptown (Where all the snooty people live). 

[h2]THANK YOU[/h2]
To everyone whose stuck around to keep testing updates and hold out hope for the project, thank you. Many of you know that I work on this project solo with some freelancers I hire for voice acting. After COVID this project isn't enough to support me so I don't have as much free time as I would like. Thank you for having the patience with me to make these updates and keep making more additions to the game. Also if you have any feedback or want to be featured as a voice in the game, audition on our server. https://discord.gg/saWwum9B . Or just stop by and chat. All are welcome

Additionally if you're not follow the project on twitter, youtube and possibly support us on Patreon or our upcoming Kickstarter if you really believe in the project. Thank you and be safe out there outlanders.

notes.title: FADE - Relaunch Demo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/a257218a106df6189a9a40acc0c480bc40a92b64.jpg[/img]
[h1]Welcome back Outlanders! [/h1]

Firstly, I would like to apologize for the great hiatus. The worlds been through alot in the past year or so and alongside it, a solo dev has to learn how to move, and move different we have. Maybe even be built different somewhat (As some say). To give those who are ready to just jump in a quick update, heres the quick notes on what's changed.

[h3]QUICK NOTES[/h3]

FADE has undergone drastic changes and is pivoting away from Unreal Engine 5. Though the improvements were a great luxury, the system requirements were too taxing on most players, and the goal is to make FADE as accessible as possible to various systems and pc set ups. Currently it is built upon Unreal Engine 4.27 and is working well. Known issues include some slight hitches in its current state, but once I am able to work out where this issue stems from, I will make adjustments to the demo and current build.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/c7042aaee6a9c96b8f38d825e9dea148d15259b2.jpg[/img]
Additionally, the current build of the game focuses on gameplay and drops the player into the start of the game without the narrative direction. To make this test as effective as possible, bosses respawn and give the player chances to try different builds and items they've discovered. Players will have access to multiple saves and be able to choose between three starting classes. Of course more are planned for launch as the races in FADE's lore still include: Baustians, Alidans, Corvians, Ugarians, and Rosarans. Each class including some others will be planned to be added upon launch, but for now its just limited to the primary three found in Baltane. To also better launch the demo release, I made a new trailer for the alpha.
[previewyoutube=CACW74DrEeQ;full][/previewyoutube]
The current build does not include an option to adjust settings as I do need to adjust to 4.27 and see how it conducts quality/performance changes differently than prior versions. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/3ed493db7e773999447a5ab11e1a408d3dc614a9.jpg[/img]
Set up for the project has changed as well. The demo includes access to all available content. I state now, if you wish to support the project, purchase the current build and get access to all future updates and the full release, but please try the demo first and make your decision based on your enjoyment.

The current build is missing some current features due to the player being gated to just the first area. Features not found in the demo include: Blacksmithing, Fishing, and Aura Shifting.

On the community end, there seems to be some issues with access/spammers attempting to access the old discord, so the community is pivoting to this new one. Join here: [url=[url=https://discord.gg/Rr5GDswYmd]New Discord[/url]]New Discord[/url]

Now to get into what happened while I was out of commission

[h3]PROJECT UPDATE[/h3]

During the hiatus I was approached by publishers hoping to assist with the games development. Despite many long talks and seemingly good arrangements, I was not able to find a publisher that fit into my designs for the project. This project means more than anything to me and it means even more to make sure that I get to be apart of future titles to make sure it stays true to my design. The goal has always been for FADE to be a classical RPG built upon a mixture of the combat of a souls-like, the skill system of dragons dogma, and the story telling of fable. To see this vision to fruition I am pushing forward and expanding the team. Additionally the project is heading to Kickstarter.

In the meantime as I ramp up towards the following goals certain facets of the project need to be explained as we have made progress despite the hiatus.

The design document for the game has been completed and location based assets have all been attained/created - Meaning the only necessary portions of game development are level building with said assets, character design for bosses and voiceover work for the many dialogue pieces in the game. 

Currently the project is seeking to fill the following positions:

notes.title: Vertical Slice Update Patch
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=fycQF5vu0gU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]Hey Outlanders![/b][/h1]
Today I am releasing a patch to FADE to help with some of the smaller issues and gripes that have been expressed in regards to the games current build.  Additionally I have made some quality of life changes that should make things easier to track and always increased the difficulty of enemies slightly.

First I'll tackle the main gripes and bugs that have been taking place. 

[h2][u][b]Level Transitions and the Loading Screen[/b][/u][/h2]
After the Update to Unreal Engine 5.1 there's been a lot of small changes that have left a few small things in shambles. I was able to tackle most of these problems through rigorous testing, but this one alluded me in the last update. The game wasn't playing the level transition movie and was forcing the game to load far too quickly. This would be fine on some builds, but taxing on others. Happy to say I was able to get it resolved and now it plays properly each time a new level is being loaded.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/3fca17dd1bf6d60983ae538ec6719d36c9e0a986.png[/img]

[h2][u][b]UI Readability and Combat Guides[/b][/u][/h2]
Some have addressed a new for more information on the players hud on how some things function, such as: Toggling equipment types, toggling between weapons, toggling between potions, etc. 

In order to remedy these issues I made the equipment display hud on the bottom left have input prompts based on your controller input to make it easier to look and see what controls are tied to those actions. This should make it easier for players to start off running instead of having to fly straight toward the controls menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/0fc0670ca5734f8ac8dd65b42d9f2e4f30e95fc1.png[/img]

[h2][u][b]Companion Strength and Survival[/b][/u][/h2]
In RPGs its important to have a fair bit of difficulty early on and to make sure players earn their way to just surviving on their own. Companions are a feature that is normally earned later on in the game. This is the case of FADE, but in this vertical slice demo you get access to your first companions very early for the sake of showing off the mechanic. In order to make the demo more challenging I have increased their HP, but greatly lowered their damage. Companion FAUST is still a powerhouse in terms of attack speed and frequency, so I shall have to head back to the drawing board to fine tune his behavior so he's more methodical and patient with his attacks. 

[h2][u][b]Demo Save and Replay-ability[/b][/u][/h2]
For the first rendition of the new update it was planned that the demo would be a one shot. Players would be prompted to create a new character each time they returned to the main menu and your overall progress would not be saved for testing purposes. Now that we are through the testing phase, I have reimplemented loading your save and now you can continue your progress from where you left off.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/bc19843e917e46aa3c4b434364f08e058f47deaf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/675bfc5e2dba34c686c7030f833385f3937687df.png[/img][/url]

[h2][u][b]Lastly, some minor fixes to the game to finish off what's changed in this patch.[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] Modified Item drops and pickups to combine with other nearby pickups on drop.
[*] Modified combat area of Ruins space to make it more open.
[*] Fixed issue where some playable classes had Stamina Cost Free Rolls.
[*] Fixed issue where Companions stats would sometimes copy the players health bar.
[*] Adjusted AI Behaviors to move to the target in more combat instances to avoid stagnation(Some instances may still occur due to still adapting to Unreal Engine 5's navigation changes)
[*] Updated some UI elements to make them more visible at higher resolutions.
[*] Added DLSS functionality which triggers if the users platform supports it.
[*] Modified damage and stagger values for different heavy weapons.
[*] Made the Great Iron hammer Available for testing in the games current build.
[/list]

Thanks for checking out the patch notes. More updates to come. As before FADE is still planning for a Kickstarter launch as to fully flesh out the content coming in future updates, we're gonna need some help. You can find our Pre-Launch Page here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/itsknightbynight/fade-a-dark-fantasy-action-rpg]Kickstarter[/url]

Also make sure to follow us on Twitter for more content and more updates on FADEs Game Development here: [url=https://twitter.com/KnightbyNight2]FADE Twitter[/url]

Be safe out there Outlander.

notes.title: THE SEEKERS UPDATE PART #4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/10f94c12b8350a09846611d3ccbc16607405420b.png[/img]
[h1]HAPPY HOLIDAYS, DEATH BRINGERS[/h1]
After a series of tweaks to performance and some additional changes to FADE, I release this new update to get feedback on some new features as well as some insight onto some recent additions upon player feedback. First, I wanna get into what's new for FADE. So far I have had a bit of issue gathering exposure for the project. It would seem that our efforts are futile. A ray of light arrived to keep me motivated while I made these new additions to the game. Ben Ormstad, a popular UE4 tutorial youtuber I learned from recently gave the game a try on his channel. Happy to report he greatly enjoyed the game. If you have the time, definitely check out the video to see his take on what's currently available in the game. 
[previewyoutube=Rfy_hrfagaU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]SO, WHATS NEW?[/h1]
Now, to get things started, the following changes and additions have been added/modified to FADE to greater improve everyone's gameplay experience.
[list]
[*] Companion Rebalancing - Modified different companions to make their kits more balanced. I noticed some of the other companions not seeing as much play and decided to go through and tackle any gripes the community had with them that lead to them being unpopular. With this team build variety should be a little easier without you feeling like you have to bring specific companions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/9ea346f6b1c9f70a860217ad1392b576504b39cb.png[/img]
[*] Weapon Fast Swap Changes - Made some animation changes to weapon type switching and toggling in order to improve fluidity for combat. Now when switching between different weapon types the player will execute an efficient shift animation and be able to attack with their weapon even sooner. This was added to improve combat for those who find themselves looking for more of a hybrid build. So far testers are finding it to be quite effective.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/7bf255d22ec8e069ac7c50bde4e8984c25290b6c.png[/img]

[*] New Temporary Companions Feature - A new system has been implemented allowing the player to have two additional companions. Each acts similar to the players base companions, but also lacks some of their functionality. For example they cannot be healed by the player. Each Temp Companion has their own methods to do so, but can also still be picked up and helped by the player. This feature was mainly added to accompany the next feature, "Random Encounters"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/5802f2cef2d86d5a9aa3d29fb541a14c7f5d77d1.png[/img]

[*] Random World Encounters - In order to give areas more life, now in special locations the player will be able to find NPCS in need hiding away with side quest for the player to embark on. This system is still fairly new and overtime shall be improved to accompany even more scenarios. For now the main scenarios include "Escort to Location", "Recover Stolen Goods", and lastly "Defeat Daunting Foe". Each of these tasks rewards the player based on their current level as well as they receive a reward from the NPC who gave the job.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/7a06f29dedb51743eb70b25403b8346af4211e54.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/315d94ae59c356f99d21ee7103220c45ca85845c.gif[/img]
[*] Toggle Sprint Feature - A setting has been added to have the option to toggle sprint on and off or hold the sprint key to sprint. This feature was implemented for those that felt that there wasn't much of a reason for them to walk considering Sprinting does not utilize stamina and didn't enjoy the tedium of holding down the sprint key.

[*] General Settings Changes - Made changes to the settings to better accompany other platforms and PCS of different qualities. By default certain settings have been set for players to experience a quality visual experience. The settings have been modified to better accommodate different players as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/d3c105e02a88a8275c4a533f5e994cd8fafaf57b.png[/img]
[/list]

[h1]SO WHAT'S NEXT?[/h1]
To update everyone on the current plans for the project I'll give a little clarity on the recent events. Despite the game having quite wondrous sales as of late, I'm still trying to acquire more funds to finish up more features in the game. Mainly voice actors at this current juncture and a few new character models.  I intend as usual to endlessly work to get this project even closer to full release. My next planned additions include the following and will be taken off as they are completed.
[olist]
[*] The Plains Demons, or the rock spider monsters as the community knows them are to be replaced by a new beast insect that Wildlings ride known as Capres. Most are known to be found in caves, but many have been domesticated to reside on the surface by the Wildlings. Prepare to face this new daunting foe.
[*] Lockpicking - In order to increase the loot variety and difficulty behind acquiring certain items, a lockpicking system shall be implemented to prepare for the future stealth/crime system.
[*] The First portion of the Castellum Sendabolg Questline - After looking through, and learning a little about METAHUMANS, I have managed to create a few vocal animations. With this tech I should be able to add more weight/emotion to the future expansion and give players access to what is complete of the new expansion. Additional portions shall be trickled in after the coming months as the work is completed.
[/olist]
That is all for now, Deathbringers. As usual make sure to leave any reviews or feedback and also if you have any questions drop it in the forums or even under this update. Also make sure to share the games last trailer to get the game out there. The more exposure, the more I can get done on the game. 
[previewyoutube=_obSiHpb3Mk;full][/previewyoutube]

 I really appreciate all the feedback and support. Lets do this everyone!

[h1]WHATS IN THIS UPDATE[/h1]
Hey, Outlanders. In this update you can expect to find some new enhancements to lighting and some of the graphical aspects of the game. Here's the quick notes.

Also in preparation of the big companion overhaul in the next update, I added an additional feature to help players prepare.

[h2]PART TIME JOBS[/h2]
Throughout FADE, as it grows into a more and more fleshed out open world RPG, the player is going to uncover areas where NPCS need lesser work to be completed. The first of these is the Blacksmithing part time job listed below. For now the players mastery level is capped, but later on there will be a separate mastery for each part time job which will help make the jobs easier based on how much to player works them. This will also be more so to gate which part time jobs the player is talented enough to help with. Pictured below is the lowest skill level of blacksmithing and thus yields a small amount of gold per completed piece.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/7d3b1605557a84b8a8b77e03b07d1fe2d7f872de.jpg[/img]
[h2]WORK MULTIPLIER[/h2]
For each job, as the player continues to achieve high quality results from their work, they will build up a multiplier. Continuing to output exceptional work will keep the multiplier high and result in a higher payout for the work done. Make sure to find your rhythm to get the best reward out of your efforts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/bfe6f67a16bc63f352e6ed9ae1d629aac10209f9.png[/img]
[h1]WHATS NEXT?[/h1]
In the next update players will be able to look forward to the following:
[list]
[*] COMPANION AWAKENING SYSTEM - Companions that reach their max level will unlock an awakening quest which will allow them to learn a new ability. The abilities will differ from companion to companion and the higher ranking the companion the better the ability.

[*] COMPANION WAGES - As the value of companions increases, the companions hiring rate is going to be shifted to also include daily wages for their equipment upkeep. At the start of each day, gold will be deducted from your inventory and should you not have enough gold a menu will pop up and have you decide on which companion to pay and who to dismiss. Make sure to watch your spending when you've got costly Outlanders on your team.

[*] COMPANIONS COMMANDS PAD - New inputs shall be added to help the player guide companions in battle and also to command them to use their awakened abilities. This should give players more control over their companions in battle and make you feel like you have more control over the battlefield.
[/list]
[h2]EXPECTED ARRIVAL
[/h2]
The expected completion of these new features is currently measured at around 6 days. I plan to tackle these new additions as soon as I complete this update with it being the weekend. Looking forward to everyones feedback on the current changes and their opinions on the new features in the near future. Thanks again guys. I couldn't ask for a more responsive and involved community.

notes.title: FADE: GRAND UPDATE 3 - THE WORLD FORWARD
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/dba17f19a94d7e4261cda4d77ec5709c9df1723f.png[/img]
[h1][b]WHATS IN THIS UPDATE?[/b][/h1]
Hey everyone, and welcome to another update for FADE. In this update new areas and quests will be made available to players alongside a series of quality of life additions upon the request of the community. Before we get into it, here's the new trailer that better showcases the direction the game is going in. I hope you enjoy. ːsteamhappyː
[previewyoutube=phBiCldKzO4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]MEET KAITHE THE UNDYING[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/ea760545a02c0619ba9f9675b451131b4dcf2df5.png[/img]
First, I am happy to announce that Kaithe finally has a key part to play within the game. His character model has been completed and placed into the game. Many will know him as the disembodied voice that speaks throughout your journey. Now players will be able to interact with him and receive an even more personalized intro. For now you have access to three specific paths to take at the start of the game to decide your playstyle in the beginning. This is due to his ability to claim hosts and use their essence to empower himself. Kaithe also possesses the ability to reshape a hosts form, this will be explored further in the character customization update.

[b][h2]NEW QUESTS AND AREAS[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/b25c73fbf5e31dedc5919c4a313525cccb9649b7.png[/img]
As new areas are added to the game, more quests will be reworked, expanded and new quests will become available as you complete the older ones. With this in place, added quests in the near future will be possible without needing to start a new run. Seek out areas you've been to before and see the new changes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/337a653316114240188479c10332dbb39bd7b705.png[/img]

[h2][b]NEW SELLING ITEMS FEATURE[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/83f26cc4b39dead187f6372ee53b38ba741dc38b.png[/img]
In this update the shop feature has been improved to include the option to sell items as well as buy them. NPC merchants will buy items specific to their profession and buy them at a discounted rate based on their friendship with the player. For now the rate is flat, but expect a change in the near future.

[b][h2]NEW CRAFTING ENHANCEMENTS AND NEW OPTION[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/9b74763b428184ecfb2b575d3aff1b0ae70a31b3.png[/img]
In order to expand the usage of materials and misc. items, across Baltane are a new type of crafting station known as the Crafting Table. Players can utilize these to craft items from recipes they've earned or found on their journey. Be on the lookout for quests with recipe rewards to further expand your combat options.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/fad49beccba0f41152656f01ddd514c1b396f28f.png[/img]

[h2][b]QUALITY OF LIFE SETTINGS CHANGES(TESTING)[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/d3c105e02a88a8275c4a533f5e994cd8fafaf57b.png[/img]
In an effort to give players more control over their game experience, a slider has been implemented to help with the games overall brightness. Adjusting this will make it easier to see in the games darker areas or for those that have naturally dark monitors. Also a beta option for controls modification has been added to allow players to remap controls. For now you can change controls for gamepad and keyboard, but this is all subject to change once I get feedback on how effective this change is. If anything gamepad may be made standard while players will be able to change keyboard controls in the menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/7eab4eda8a7da18223f40ba6f19c48864602cbf6.png[/img]

[h1][b]PLANNED ADDITIONS[/b][/h1]
Now that that's out of the way I'm going to go more into detail on things planned for the future of fade. The following goals are what's next for the project:

[list]
[*] PHASE TWO - Phase two includes what takes place after the Silver Seeker Quest. To begin this process I will need to reach out and have more character models made for the actors that play a significant role in the next update. This will be approached with UE4 META HUMANS in mind. The hope is to convert the project to UE5 or UE 4.26 and to attempt to create detailed models with capabilities for facial animation. Once attained the player will quest to a new Sea Town area being oppressed by raids of sea creatures that seem to be rising from a sunken castellum.
[/list]

[list]
[*] COMPANION CHANGES - In the next update companions will be enhanced even further to have an Awakening ability. This ability is unlocked by getting the companion to level 15 and completing their companion specific quest. These abilities have a cooldown, are going to be what truly sets your companion apart from the others. For Example: A bowman in the game receives an ability to rain a barrage of arrows on foes.
[/list]

[list]
[*] COMPANION WAGES - In order to immerse the player further and increase the flow of currency in the game, Companions will now have wages that are charged each day in game. If the player lacks the sufficient funds, the companion will leave the party and return to their initial locations. These wages will differ based on companion level and companion rank.
[/list]

[list]
[*] MINIGAMES AND WORLD JOBS - In order to provide more options to the player other than selling items or killing foes, new job minigames will be added. These jobs will be based on profession, such as blacksmithing, mining, or logging. These minigames will include simple acts such as, striking metal at the correct timing to perfect an iron craft, cutting logs, and possibly tailoring. The most difficult of which is the Deep Dive mini game. In this mini game the player will work with the Briarstone Miners to dive into the deep tunnels they cannot venture. Here the player will have a limited time to mine as many metals as possible, while facing dangerous foes.
[/list]

MORE LEGENDARIES - Won't say to much in the way of spoilers, but more legendary weapons are on the way in the next update. Each with a unique ability and gimmick. Good luck earning them, Death Bringer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/ba26e9344249aca02a70e35f690d8fd571382fe9.png[/img]

With that, that's everything I wanted to speak on everyone. I'm excited to bring you the next update in the future and I'm looking forward to even more feedback on the new changes. Thank you for you time and patience. Have fun out there, Death Bringer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/cca4915af55d4726caab20ed2d73041eeafa7317.png[/img]

notes.title: FADE SPELL FORGING UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/c2e68e0ee8bf4fd2047aab7c587db4888fd1c18e.png[/img]
[h1]WHATS IN THIS UPDATE?[/h1]
Across the Baltane Valley the player will encounter many foes with varying elemental alignments. Some of these enemies will be primitive and cling to scratch stones of certain elements for use in combat. While traveling the player will now be able to face off against these foes and claim scratch stones from their bodies. Scratch stones are used to bind elements to perform simple spells. By combining a scratch stones with one of the four extremely rare Catalyst Runes (Defense, Violence, Seeking, and Sanctuary) you can create incredible spells. But choose wisely, for Runes are very rare.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/e4ec0602ab1a3f216b1f6b56665d2bfe8682291d.jpg[/img]
Pictured below is a Mana golem created by the player using the Animate Golem spell. This spell is a targeted summon, meaning the player can choose where the spawn the golem. Wherever the creature animates a large shockwave will also take place, knocking foes into the air.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/6055cca6b1897465b3b7dac7d6c0d6e51df0dd4e.jpg[/img]
[h1]ADDITIONAL CHANGES[/h1]
[previewyoutube=5n2eizm1WCU;full][/previewyoutube]
To go along with the new changes some buffs have been made to physical skills as well as some balancing to their stamina/mana cost. Some weapons now have special skills bound to them and soon more will as well. In order to deepen the combat system, each weapon will have one skill from its specific class bound to it, to make sure that wielders will be able to diversify which skills they choose to take into fights.
[h1]PLANNED[/h1]
Lastly, in the coming update the new objective now that the spell crafting system has been implemented is to not only add more combat skills, but to also deepen the companion system. The goal is to make it so as soon as a companion levels up to a certain threshold they will supply the player with an additional quest to deepen their bond. Completing this quest will not only reward the player, but allow the companion to take on a different appearance.

So far I am really enjoying the feedback from all the players out there. Currently more than 600 and rising have tried the game. All I ask is that you make sure to leave your review. Your feedback means leagues to me and will only help in making the project better. Finally for anyone new here, make sure to check out the last devlog if you're interested. New devlog coming soon. That's it for me. Be careful out there Outlander.

notes.title: FADE MAJOR UPDATE 1.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/15b76a141b3b7dee014a4d9859f12a2cf538ca5c.png[/img]
[h3]THE TUTORIAL UPDATE[/h3]
This update has a major focus on gameplay improvements based on your feedback as well as the newest string of planned game additions. At the end I will also list the next planned changes for the next update. Also these update changes are going to be in my new devlog video on the game later this week, so if you wanted to see them displayed in a video heres a link to the [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCG168K3XifgbiN-NjcYm5zQ]youtube channel[/url]
Also FADE is now available as a category on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/FADE%20THE%20FIRST%20CHAPTER]TWITCH.TV HERE[/url]
First, these are the most recent new additions to FADE: The First Chapter
[list]
[*] THE QUICK MENU - The quick menu was made based on feedback from players stating that it is difficult to maintain their companions HP while in combat and also keep track of their companions current status without having to pause the game. With this the player can slow the flow of combat for a moment to take some time to heal companions as well as tell them to follow or wait.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/678258e7e7dd1209f8358c681ed4d734e9b2254c.png[/img]
[list]
[*] NEW TUTORIAL - In place of the old tutorial which displayed the main character in their past life, the tutorial now better explains the players current situation and allows them a direct path towards the first Soul Mantle Boss. This will give players more direction and urgency to the story as it also leads directly into the opening of the game. Later on dialogue will be added to the opening to elaborate on this further.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/bf97a229a8aa76aac22bc5f2db3f04f74224318b.png[/img]
[list]
[*] THE SOUL MANTLE - Speaking of the Soul Mantle, the player will now be able to change their equipped weapon type skills as they go up in mastery level by speaking with specialist with each weapon type. Currently the player can learn new: Sword and Shield Skills, Two Handed Skills, and Bow Skills. In future updates the player will be able to recruit new trainers to learn even more skills.
[/list]
[list]
[*] NPC IMPROVEMENTS AND SHOP CHANGES - NPCs now have more informative dialogue options to help inform the player of possible options. This also includes giving the player access to two new companion types: Archers and Mages. Over the course of receiving feedback these npcs will be buffed and nerfed accordingly. The prices of certain items and placement of items in the world have been shifted to adjust to the new weapon stat changes. 
[/list]
[list]
[*] ENEMY CHANGES - No screenshots for this mainly to make sure enemy changes come as a surprise for those new to the game as well as veterans. Different enemies have been given new skills to help them better fit into their archetypes: For Example - Assassin type enemies now have skills to reflect their knowledge, such as teleporting and throwing daggers. Overtime I plan to add even more specialized enemies to amplify the difficulty of the game.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/c2e68e0ee8bf4fd2047aab7c587db4888fd1c18e.png[/img]
Lastly, Heres a list of future additions planned to be added to the game. Each of these is ordered based on level of importance.
[h3]NEW AREAS[/h3]
[list]
[*] NEW AREA - BRIARSTONE COPSE - Briarstone copse is a once profitable town solely owned by the Briarstone Family. They faced dire issues fighting the Wildlings, this forces them to take in survivors in exchange for protection from the Baltane Fortress. Despite them being safer than before, their new allies causes a new threat to their way of life.
[/list]
[list]
[*]NEW AREA - BALTANE CASTLE - Once at a higher rank, the player will be capable to join the ranks of the Baltane Knights to take on tasks that only they have access to and get to an area of the map once off limits to them. Baltane Castle is the backbone of the people of the Baltane Valley and may hold one of its darkest secrets.
[/list]
[list]
[*] NEW AREA - THE RUINS OF FAL'RAH - A home once known to hold incredibly rare tools imbued with ancient magic has now become overrun with spirits summoned to protect the site. No one has been able to set foot within its chambers in a year, and now its your turn to try. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/2c15392b363f21d4cd1e5aa3a32000f7fbfef053.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076503/d5faa3f09b4dfd6529a8f758a8397c6aa03808bd.png[/img]
[list]
[*] NEW FIELD BOSSES - Each area will be given a random chance to spawn different field bosses based on time of day. The armored spider may be a rare enemy, but may even appear in the wild. The next mini boss planned to be designed is a roaming injured dragon.
[/list]
 Thanks for checking out the update notes. Looking forward to everyone's feedback on this new update. I'm hoping to drop it within the next few days. 

[h3]HAPPY NEW YEAR EVERYONE AND MAKER GUIDE YOU, OUTLANDER.[/h3]
